children: The U.K. government borrowed more in August than a year earlier, a setback for its plans to reduce its deficit as it prepares to outline a new budget next month.

The Office for National Statistics Tuesday said government spending exceeded its revenues by 18.3 billion pounds ($24.46 billion), an increase in the budget deficit of 2.9 billion pounds from August 2025.

For the fiscal year to date, borrowing totaled 77.3 billion pounds, a decline of 2.2 billion pounds compared to the same period last year, but 8.1 billion pounds above projections published by the Office for Budget Responsibility in March.
